## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 49 captures during May 2020. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. Activity should continue to be monitored through routine service reporting so that any changes in workload can be identified promptly and considered alongside image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

There were 2 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 4.1 per cent. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk by the clinic lead. Timely logging will support review of equipment performance and help the service determine whether further technical action is required.

## Grading

A total of 5 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 1. This measure should be reviewed with the monthly activity and image-quality results to support oversight of the service and identify any emerging operational concerns.
